content:
- Overestimate prices after strong positive sentiment spikes; model tends to overshoot in bullish phases.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is consistently negative or neutral; model fails to reflect downward pressure.
- Model exhibits lag in responding to sentiment shifts — especially when sentiment turns negative, forecast remains high for 2–3 days.
- When sentiment is mixed or volatile, model overfits recent trends and ignores mean reversion signals.
- Forecast horizon 30d often overestimates peak prices in early-to-mid period, then underestimates late-period corrections.
- If sentiment history shows repeated short-term reversals, model should reduce volatility in forecast slope.
- Avoid extrapolating upward from recent highs if sentiment is declining; model tends to ignore sentiment-driven corrections.
- When sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, model should not overreact to minor price dips — expect mean reversion, not continuation.
